name: Hero Cam Cafe

location.address: No. 39, north side of Hameila Blvd, Punak, Tehran

media.alt: Real photo from Hero Cam Cafe's Instagram

description: 'A place for a cup of peace': clean modern interior plus a planted courtyard on Hameila Blvd. Fresh coffee, full breakfasts, desserts and hookah from about 8:00 to midnight. Calm and friendly for dates or catch-ups; not a specialty bar or laptop spot. Courtyard is the best seat.
